articles.title: Robots That Admit 'I'm Not Sure' Are the Future of AI
articles.summary: Most robots fail when facing unfamiliar tasks. Yen-Ling Kuo's award-winning method lets robots estimate their own uncertainty, reducing errors and human supervision. Her work could transform interactive robot learning in unpredictable environments.

articles.title: Meet Brötchen: Berlin's Baby Pygmy Hippo Is a Conservation Symbol
articles.summary: A female pygmy hippo born at Zoo Berlin has been named Brötchen—'breadroll' in German. While her online fame grows, the species faces a critical threat: fewer than 2,500 adults remain in West African forests due to habitat loss.

articles.title: Dramatic Rescue Frees Humpback Whale from Life-Threatening Entanglement
articles.summary: A juvenile humpback whale anchored by fishing gear near Stellwagen Bank was freed by CCS's disentanglement team. Using a 30-foot pole with a hook-shaped knife, rescuers cut the ropes in worsening weather. The whale is expected to recover.
